facts.business: Kanco Tea & Industries Limited is engaged in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of tea.
key_risks: Estimation of useful life of bearer plants involves significant management judgement and changes in natural factors may affect useful life expectancy and carrying value.
Valuation of biological assets and agricultural produce requires significant management estimates under Ind AS 41.
facts.related_party_note: Borrowings from directors are disclosed; remuneration paid to directors and KMPs as per policy.
